The 3 events are: SK hynix/SanDisk first open HBF standard; Kioxia/SanDisk 332-layer QLC NAND; SK hynix V10 375-layer 4D NAND.

For EACH of the 3 events, write ONE brief item object. The item must be a Chinese technical brief for an internal leadership/eng audience, grounded ONLY in the facts provided (do not invent numbers). Each item object has these string fields (ALL in Chinese, each a COMPLETE sentence ending with 。 or ！ or ？ — no ellipsis, no dangling punctuation):

- `core_conclusion`: 25–75 chars. The one-sentence headline technical change.
- `mechanism`: 18–50 chars. How it works / what changed technically.
- `result`: 18–50 chars. The quantified outcome (use the real numbers from facts: layer count, Gb/mm², TB/s, power multiplier, dates).
- `project_relevance`: 18–50 chars. Why it matters for system/storage-hierarchy judgment.
- `boundary`: 10–35 chars. A limit / what it is NOT (e.g. 不是HBM替代、尚未量产、仅送样).
- `summary`: a 1-2 sentence Chinese summary of the whole item (≈60-100 chars).

TOTAL of (core_conclusion+mechanism+result+project_relevance+boundary) must be 180–260 chars. Count carefully. Every field ends with 。/！/？. Use concrete numbers from the facts (375层, 332层, >37 Gb/mm², 4.8 Gb/s, 512GB, 3TB/s, 2.5倍, etc.) — only numbers actually present in the facts.

Also include per item: `event_id` (copy from the input), `score` (int, use the item_input.score if present else 80), `source_urls` (list of the source urls from item_input.sources), and `incremental_update` (false).

Write the result to EXACTLY: `/Users/qiliangli/.claude/jobs/c87757ec/tmp/media_items_output.json`
Shape:
```
[{"event_id":"<id>", "item": {core_conclusion, mechanism, result, project_relevance, boundary, summary, score, source_urls, incremental_update}, ...}, ...]
```
(3 elements, one per event_id, in any order.)

Constraints:
- Do NOT modify product code/prompts/schemas/config. Do NOT run briefing.py.
- Stay strictly within the char limits; re-count before writing.
- Ground every number in the provided facts.

When done, reply with the 3 core_conclusion strings and each item's total char count.
